answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 46847 Country: India Title: nikah of shia and sunni Question: I have a question. A Shia boy having Sunni mother and grandmother, wishes to marry a Sunni girl with all Sunni rituals and boy itself not following false Shia sayings as guided by mother, now please tell me what to do? Answer ID: 46847 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1222/1120/N=9/1434) Shias generally hide their true face under the cover of taqayya; therefore it is against precaution for a Sunni girl to marry a Shia boy though he repents from his Shia beliefs and practices. Yes, if he is believed by his friends especially religious and knowledgeable persons to be a true Sunni, then a Sunni girl can marry him. However, one should exercise maximum care in marrying a Shia. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
